source_context: Immediate continuation of runtime/current_scene.json after Arlequino delegated organizer search, Eurazania evacuation inquiry, and new-home search to Rena.
rena_response: Организатора найду. По людям Эуразании начну с гильдий и караванщиков — там быстрее всего всплывут маршруты эвакуации. По дому посмотрю варианты, но ничего не буду бронировать или покупать без нас обоих. Сначала закончим здесь.
durable_effects: Rena explicitly acknowledges all three delegated tasks.
For the evacuation inquiry, her initial chosen channels are guilds and caravan/merchant networks; this is a plan, not a completed investigation.
For housing, she will gather options but will not reserve or purchase property unilaterally under the current delegation.
She prioritizes finishing the current student-hall meeting before beginning off-screen work.
knowledge_boundary: No new fact about Eurazania evacuee destinations, the destroyed capital, Carrion, or the Old Garden Street home is learned in this event.
player_agency: No new deliberate action, thought, feeling, or speech is assigned to Arlequino.
